name: tell_me
title: Section C · an agent's run stays out of the stream, until the person asks to be told

steps.result: This is my first run: there are **2 listings** in the Listings table, Harbour Car Wash and Corner Print Shop.

steps.say: From now on, tell me here whenever Listing Watch finds a new listing.
steps.reply:
Done. From now on, each time Listing Watch runs, what it finds will show up here in our conversation. It checks every Monday at 09:00, so the next check is Monday 26 October. If your Mac is asleep then, it runs when the Mac next wakes.

Right now it knows about 2 listings: Harbour Car Wash and Corner Print Shop. Anything new after those will be named here. If you ever want this to stop, just say so.

steps.result: There's one new listing since my last run: **Lakeside Bakery**.

steps.say: Stop telling me about Listing Watch.
steps.reply:
Done, Listing Watch's results will no longer come here. It still checks every Monday at 09:00, and you can see what it finds on its own page.

Its last check, which ran just before you turned this off, found one new listing: **Lakeside Bakery**.

steps.result: There's one new listing since my last run: **Sunbelt Laundry**.
